title: Listen and Choose a Response — Course Planning

questions.stem: Aren't you taking Professor Lee's writing class this term?

options.A: She teaches in the humanities building.
options.B: Yes, I took it two years ago.
options.C: The writing center is open till nine.
options.D: I wanted to, but it was already full.

questions.explanation: Explaining why the class couldn't be taken answers the question; the 'Yes' option uses the wrong tense.
questions.speaker: f3
